create.name: Dr. Sue Morter
create.bio:
Dr. Sue Morter is an American teacher of energy-based spiritual practice and the founder of the Morter Institute, whose home is in Carmel, Indiana. She spent decades working in bio-energetics, the field of her father, Dr. M. T. Morter Jr., and together they developed the Bio-Energetic Synchronization Technique. Over some twenty-five years, a series of deep experiences in meditation then turned her attention towards awakening and the nature of the self.

Out of that came The Energy Codes, a step-by-step method that combines breath, attention to the core of the body and movement, so that people can live from what she calls the Soulful Self. She also created BodyAwake Yoga, a style that pairs familiar postures with breath and subtle-energy work, and runs a school that certifies teachers in it. Her books The Energy Codes and The Anatomy of Awakening both reached the New York Times best-seller list. Students meet her through a year-long mentorship, online courses and memberships, live events, a monthly podcast called The Art of Awakening, and her YouTube channel, where she talks with guests about consciousness, science and the inner life.

courses.title: BodyAwake Yoga Membership
courses.description: An online yoga membership with a library of streamed BodyAwake classes and two new live classes each month. Classes run from beginner to advanced, with chair options.

courses.title: BodyAwake Yoga Intensive & Asana Training
courses.description: A self-paced deep dive into BodyAwake Yoga, its postures and the breath and energy principles behind them. It is also the first step towards teacher certification.

courses.title: BodyAwake Yoga Teacher Certification
courses.description: A year-long training for people who want to teach BodyAwake Yoga, with a route that also leads to RYT-200 registration. The next cohort starts on 1 March 2027.

courses.title: The Energy Codes Certified Coaching Program
courses.description: A live online training for people who want to coach others in The Energy Codes. Modules run from January to April 2027, with replays available afterwards.

free_resources.title: Free BodyAwake Yoga Class
free_resources.description: A free half-hour BodyAwake Yoga practice led by Dr. Sue. It brings breath and movement together as an introduction to her style.

free_resources.title: Guided Meditation with Dr. Sue Morter
free_resources.description: A free guided meditation from Dr. Sue's BodyAwake school, meant to help you sense and wake up your own energy. It is one of the complimentary tools listed on her free gifts page.
